<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844" width="390" height="844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="24" y="26" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#050505">9:41</text>
  <rect x="334" y="15" width="22" height="11" rx="2.67" fill="none" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.35"/>
  <rect x="356" y="18" width="1.33" height="4" fill="#050505" opacity="0.4"/>
  <rect x="336" y="18" width="18" height="7.33" rx="1.33" fill="#050505"/>
  <circle cx="315" cy="20" r="2.2" fill="#050505"/>
  <circle cx="325" cy="20" r="2.2" fill="#050505"/>
  <line x1="300" y1="20" x2="306" y2="20" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="310" y1="20" x2="312" y2="20" stroke="#050505" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <text x="24" y="84" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="34" font-weight="700" fill="#1877F2">Hello!</text>
  <text x="24" y="113" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">Signup to get Started</text>
  <text x="24" y="140" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">Create your account to continue and recover from validation errors.</text>

  <!-- username field -->
  <text x="24" y="182" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">Username</text>
  <rect x="24" y="192" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#FFF3F8" stroke="#C30052" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="38" y="222" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#050505">alex.jordan</text>
  <circle cx="346" cy="216" r="9" fill="#ED2E7E"/>
  <line x1="340.5" y1="210.5" x2="351.5" y2="221.5" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="351.5" y1="210.5" x2="340.5" y2="221.5" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text x="24" y="257" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#C30052">Username is invalid. Use 3–20 letters, numbers, or underscores.</text>

  <!-- password field -->
  <text x="24" y="298" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">Password</text>
  <rect x="24" y="308" width="342" height="48" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="38" y="338" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#050505">••••••••••••</text>
  <circle cx="338" cy="332" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="332.5" y1="326.5" x2="343.5" y2="337.5" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="340" y1="315" x2="340" y2="324" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="336" y1="319" x2="344" y2="319" stroke="#667080" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- remember/forgot -->
  <rect x="24" y="372" width="24" height="24" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#4E4B66" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polyline points="30,384 34,388 41,378" fill="none" stroke="#1877F2" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="56" y="389" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">Remember me</text>
  <text x="241" y="389" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#1877F2">Forgot the password?</text>

  <!-- login button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="420" width="342" height="50" rx="6" fill="#1877F2"/>
    <text x="195" y="452" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Login</text>
  </g>

  <line x1="24" y1="496" x2="154" y2="496" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="164" y="500" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">or continue with</text>
  <line x1="279" y1="496" x2="366" y2="496" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- social buttons -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="514" width="165" height="48" rx="6" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="538" r="11" fill="#18ACFE"/>
    <path d="M48 538l4-3 3 2 5-6" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="74" y="543" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#667080">Facebook</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="201" y="514" width="165" height="48" rx="6" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
    <circle cx="229" cy="538" r="11" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D1D5DB" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="229" y="543" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#4285F4">G</text>
    <text x="251" y="543" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#667080">Google</text>
  </g>

  <!-- trust / alternate actions -->
  <rect x="24" y="582" width="342" height="74" rx="6" fill="#FAFAFA" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="40" y="607" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#050505">Security note</text>
  <text x="40" y="629" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">We’ll keep you signed in on this device if you choose “Remember me”.</text>
  <circle cx="337" cy="619" r="16" fill="#FFF3F8" stroke="#ED2E7E" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="337" y1="611" x2="337" y2="621" stroke="#ED2E7E" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="337" cy="626" r="1.7" fill="#ED2E7E"/>

  <!-- signup hint -->
  <text x="78" y="695" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">Don’t have an account?</text>
  <text x="239" y="695" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#1877F2">Sign Up</text>

  <!-- bottom nav -->
  <rect x="0" y="766" width="390" height="78" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="766" x2="390" y2="766" stroke="#EEF1F4" stroke-width="1"/>

  <g transform="translate(30,780)">
    <polygon points="18,6 30,16 6,16" fill="#4E4B66"/>
    <rect x="9" y="16" width="18" height="14" rx="2" fill="#4E4B66"/>
    <text x="18" y="52" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#4E4B66">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(108,780)">
    <circle cx="18" cy="13" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="24" y1="19" x2="30" y2="25" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="18" y="52" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#A0A3BD">Search</text>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(186,780)">
    <rect x="10" y="6" width="16" height="18" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="10,12 18,18 26,12" fill="none" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="18" y="52" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#A0A3BD">Inbox</text>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(264,780)">
    <rect x="10" y="7" width="18" height="18" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#A0A3BD" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="19" cy="16" r="4" fill="#A0A3BD"/>
    <text x="19" y="52" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#A0A3BD">Saved</text>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(330,780)">
    <circle cx="18" cy="12" r="9" fill="#EEF1F4"/>
    <circle cx="18" cy="10" r="3.5" fill="#A0A3BD"/>
    <rect x="11" y="16" width="14" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A0A3BD"/>
    <text x="18" y="52" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#A0A3BD">Profile</text>
  </g>

  <!-- subtle footer card to fill space -->
  <rect x="24" y="720" width="342" height="34" rx="6" fill="#FFF3F8" stroke="#F6D3E1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="40" y="742" font-family="Poppins, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#C30052">Tip: check the username format or try a different account.</text>
</svg>
